resolutions.researcher_notes: OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2012, Table 4.10 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2011' (printed p.75, PDF page 78) lists 'Hawiyah/Uthmaniyah  Saudi Aramco  29  32' among existing gas pipelines. Membership in this table of in-service pipelines supports status=operating by context (the word 'operating' does not appear). Live opec.org PDF now redirects to an HTML error page, so Wayback snapshot (2025-01-10) cited. url_verifier cannot read PDF binaries (returns FAIL); value confirmed by pdfplumber text extraction of page 78. Single strong source for the specific line -> medium.

OPEC ASB2012 Table 4.10 is explicitly 'Gas pipelines' and lists the Hawiyah/Uthmaniyah line. Saudipedia (Saudi govt reference, independent of OPEC/GEM) states 'Sales gas produced at the Hawiyah Gas Plant is sent to the adjacent NGL recovery plant' -> the Hawiyah facility handles sales/natural gas. Two independent sources support Fuel=Gas.

OPEC ASB2012 Table 4.10 gives length 29 for the Hawiyah/Uthmaniyah line. The table header units are MILES ('Length (miles)'), so 29 mi = 46.7 km ~= 47 km, matching GEM's LengthKnown=47.00 km (GEM converted miles->km). Only OPEC gives this figure; Aramco materials describe other Hawiyah-Uthmaniyah lines (a 56-in NGL/rich-gas line and an 85-km CO2 line) but not this 32-in line's length -> single source, medium.

OPEC ASB2012 Table 4.10 diameter column shows 32 (inches) for Hawiyah/Uthmaniyah, matching GEM Diameter=32 in. Sole source for this specific line; other documented Hawiyah-Uthmaniyah pipes are 56-in (NGL/rich gas), so the 32-in value is distinct and OPEC-only -> medium.

GEM FuelSource='Al Hawiyah' = the Hawiyah Gas Plant, the pipeline's origin. OPEC ASB2012 lists the line's start as 'Hawiyah'. Saudipedia independently describes the Hawiyah Gas Plant producing sales gas. Both support the fuel originating at Al Hawiyah.

OPEC ASB2012 names the endpoints 'Hawiyah/Uthmaniyah' (Saudi Arabia), matching GEM EndLocation=Uthmaniya, both in Saudi Arabia. Saudipedia independently ties the Hawiyah plant to Uthmaniyah (references an 85-km Hawiyah->Uthmaniyah line) confirming the endpoint pair and country. CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: GEM 'StartState/Province'=Makkah is almost certainly wrong -- the Hawiyah Gas Plant and Uthmaniyah are both in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province, not the Makkah region; GEM correctly lists EndState/Province=Eastern Province for Uthmaniya. Recommend Update review StartState=Makkah -> Eastern Province. Tier medium because no source confirms the 'Makkah' province and the endpoint corroboration comes from a facility article rather than a pipeline-specific one.

OPEC ASB2012 lists owner/operator = 'Saudi Aramco' for the Hawiyah/Uthmaniyah line, matching GEM Owner1=Saudi Aramco 100%. Saudipedia independently states Saudi Aramco operates the Hawiyah Gas Plant. Two independent sources -> high. (Aramco owns 100% of Master Gas System pipelines linking its gas plants, consistent with 100%.)
